title: Bacon Apples
description: Brown sugar apples topped with bacon is a perfect combination of sweet and salty, a quick and easy camping recipe the whole family will love.
ingredients: 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon, or more to taste

steps.text: Build a campfire and allow the fire to burn until it has accumulated a bed of coals. Rake the coals into a flat bed on one side of the fire. Alternatively, preheat an outdoor grill.
Place apples in a loaf pan. Combine brown sugar and cinnamon in a bowl; spoon into each apple.

Place the loaf pan into the campfire or on the grill; cook for about 3 minutes. Carefully remove the pan from the fire and sprinkle bacon over apples. Place in the fire or on the grill for about 5 minutes more.

video.description: Campfire dessert will win the day when you serve up these hot apples stuffed with gooey melted caramel and salty bacon! Core apples and fill up with brown sugar and cinnamon. Wrap in foil and set into a pan near your fire or coals. When all melted into tempting caramel, shovel in pieces of bacon, re-wrap, and cook near the fire some more. Open, slice, and eat the most delicious caramel apple ever under the stars!
